# Álvaro Brey

> Álvaro Brey is a senior Android engineer from Santiago de Compostela, Spain, with experience in DevOps, web frontend and scripting.

Personal site and CV of Álvaro Brey. Every page below is also served as Markdown at the same path with a `.md` suffix.

- [Home](https://alvarobrey.com/index.md): Álvaro Brey is a senior Android engineer from Santiago de Compostela, Spain, with experience in DevOps, web frontend and scripting.
- [About me](https://alvarobrey.com/me.md): Álvaro Brey is an Android-focused software engineer who cares about automation, developer experience and open-source software.
- [My CV](https://alvarobrey.com/cv.md): The career of Álvaro Brey, senior Android engineer: work history, education and open-source projects, with a downloadable PDF CV.
- [Contact](https://alvarobrey.com/contact.md): Get in touch with Álvaro Brey, senior Android engineer, by email, LinkedIn or GitHub.
- [About this page](https://alvarobrey.com/about.md): How alvarobrey.com is built: a static SvelteKit site in TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, open source on GitHub and deployed to GitHub Pages.
- [Privacy](https://alvarobrey.com/privacy.md): What alvarobrey.com stores and collects: a theme preference in your browser, cookieless analytics, and nothing else.
